bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
c=deploy-gaybbs-1
docker inspect "$c" >/dev/null
echo "CONTAINER_STATUS=$(docker inspect "$c" --format '{{.State.Status}}')"
echo "RESTART_COUNT=$(docker inspect "$c" --format '{{.RestartCount}}')"
now=$(docker inspect "$c" --format '{{.Image}}')
old=$(docker image inspect gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:rollback-applicant-48134d4 --format '{{.Id}}')
new=$(docker image inspect gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:applicant-live-48134d4 --format '{{.Id}}')
if test "$now" = "$old"; then echo CURRENT_IMAGE=ROLLBACK; elif test "$now" = "$new"; then echo CURRENT_IMAGE=NEW; else echo CURRENT_IMAGE=OTHER; fi
if docker logs --since 180s "$c" 2>&1 | grep -E -i 'ready|polling|fatal|error|start' | sed -E 's/[0-9]{8,}/[ID]/g' | tail -n 12; then :; fi
echo READBACK_DONE
